facts.text: Sir Alfred, the undead knight in the Barrow Mound, is incapacitated but not destroyed; he may recover and attack anyone who returns to the mound, the party included.
If Sir Alfred recovers, he may kill more Free Goblin Society members, who are settling in the Barrow Mound; the goblins say he already killed all their friends down there.
Why does Sir Alfred, a seven-foot undead knight with a greatsword and a bronze death mask, roam the Barrow Mound?
Brother Dirk regards Sir Alfred as holy and would rather the party not destroy him. Why does he consider this undead knight holy?
